prompts.text: Identify ambiguity, over-specification, missing oracles, false-success risks, and unsafe authority promotion. Return proposals only.
Derive only proposed intent, ambiguity, non-goals, and unresolved questions from the selected intent sources. Do not infer implementation facts or authority.
Propose bounded criteria, evidence classes, source-only checks, future capability requirements, limitations, and owner questions. Do not claim acceptance or verification.
Return exactly one JSON object with keys model_reviewed_implications and unresolved; each value must be a bounded array of strings. Return no other keys or prose.
Reconcile two frozen independent paths while preserving disagreements and provenance. Do not invent authority or runtime evidence.
